leadText:
Set Sail (Chinese: Qǐháng) is the opening theme for the dub of the first season of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, . It debuted in HZ002, replacing Aim to Be a Pokémon Master -with my friends-. The opening animation has two versions that use the same footage as the corresponding Japanese opening themes, Heart-Pounding Diary and Halo.

The opening animation video for the song was released on various mainland Chinese social media platforms on January 17, 2025 as a trailer to promote the launch of the Pokémon Trading Card Game product .

The opening animation has two versions that use the same footage as the corresponding Japanese opening themes, Heart-Pounding Diary and Halo.

The opening animation video for the song was released on various mainland Chinese social media platforms on January 17, 2025 as a trailer to promote the launch of the Pokémon Trading Card Game product .

==Opening animation: Version 1 (HZ001 - HZ025)==
===Synopsis===
Liko and are enjoying the breeze outside the Brave Olivine's observation room together. The camera quickly pans up to the sky and the series logo appears.

Friede enters the Captain's deck to check on Captain Pikachu and . A hardworking Orla wipes her forehead before exchanging a look with and . In the kitchen, Murdock's fills a bowl with cream as Murdock and are ready to make something out of it. Mollie is in the nursery with , , , , and , turning around in her chair as Chansey carries a tray to the opposite end of the room. Roy and skip and swing around together through a forest as various Pokémon they've encountered pass by in the opposite direction. Nidothing and dance and get up into the fourth wall. Ludlow is fishing in the sunset as a and three fly by him. 

At night, Liko has her coat off and is on her Rotom Pad. She pets Sprigatito before looking out her window at the moon. A transition of her singing along with uncertainty panning to the left turns the screen blue. The next scene starts with Liko's feet walking to the rhythm of Sprigatito's wagging tail, and then Roy's hat swaying the rhythm of Fuecoco's head swaying. Liko holds her pendant before letting go, causing it to glow brightly as the camera zooms out. Liko and Roy lay down on the battlefield, exhausted as their partners come to their sides and they exchange a laugh. The camera zooms out, with Friede and his Pokémon watching the two, and a shooting star crosses over the ocean.

Liko commands Sprigatito to use , which Roy has Fuecoco counter with . Orla, on her , and Murdock watch their battle. Mollie, Quaxly, and Ludlow are in the next scene. , and then Friede with Charizard, and then Captain Pikachu are in the next. Roy holds one of the ancient adventurer's Poké Balls, gazing up at the clear sky surrounded by clouds where the Black Rayquaza flies overhead. Amethio battles Friede's Charizard with his , with fire in Friede's eyes. In the meeting room, Murdock places mugs around as the other Rising Volt Tacklers come in and are impressed. Liko and Sprigatito face away from the fourth wall, standing before clouds moving in the opposite direction she is facing. Liko becomes surprised when the other Rising Volt Tacklers walk by her and towards the Brave Olivine. They all turn around to Liko, with Roy waving for her to come along. Sprigatito jumps on Liko's shoulder and nuzzles her cheek, and she runs to join the Rising Volt Tacklers.

The final shot shows all the Rising Volt Tacklers walking together in front of the Brave Olivine. Liko, Roy, and their partners are in the center with Charizard and Captain Pikachu above them. Friede, Orla, Dot, Ludlow, and Quaxly are on the right with Metagross flying above them. Murdock, Mollie, Chansey, and Rockruff are on the left.

==Opening animation: Version 2 (HZ026 - HZ045)==
===Synopsis===
The black background is lit up as the pendant floats down between Liko's hands and turns into . The camera zooms across the sea before the series logo appears in front of the sunset.

Young Liko speaks as she walks with her parents through a market when the background turns gray. On a blue background, Liko's look of uncertainty is lifted. As she lifts her pendant up to the blue moon while sitting on the rooftop, green leaves of energy surround her and disappear to show Liko, , , and Terapagos enjoying the breeze outside the Brave Olivine's observation room together. Young Roy is amazed at the ancient adventurer story his grandpa shows him. On a dirt road, a dirtied Roy is wearing the Rising Volt Tacklers' flag as a cape while he gazes at his Ancient Poké Ball before confidently raising it up to the sky. A circle of flames surrounds him and disappears to show Roy, , and watching the sunset on the Brave Olivine's wing deck together. Transitions with lines showing off the Rising Volt Tacklers and their occur, starting with Friede and , Orla and / , Mollie and , Dot and , Murdock and / , Ludlow and , ending with Captain Pikachu and Friede at the wheel in the captain's deck.

The Brave Olivine rises from the clouds, with Liko and Roy on the front, Dot, Orla, Mollie, Murdock, and Ludlow outside the observation deck, and the flying next to the ship. Terapagos runs along Rayquaza's back, followed by Liko, Roy, Dot, Murdock, and Ludlow, with Orla and Mollie riding on Metagross. As Amethio trains and at the Explorers' base, he starts to feel exhausted as Hamber and oversee his progress.

Liko is next to Diana and Lucca as she holds Terapagos, who releases light from its shell. Projections of , , , , , and Rayquaza appear, ending with Lucius as the camera zooms into his blue eye. At sunset, Sprigatito, Terapagos, and Liko walk towards Lucius overlooking the sea on a cliff. The next shots are off the Explorer admins; Coral on 's head, Sidian walking with , and Chalce doing a kung fu pose with . Roy wakes up Liko from her dream. Scenes show of Zirc and Onia tending to and , Spinel with in front of Gibeon's monolith, and someone charging up a Tera Orb. As the Rising Volt Tacklers look to the sky, Lucius's belt is shown next to his memoirs. Terapagos is in its as someone reaches for it.

The final shot shows the Rising Volt Tacklers' hands doing their trademark handshake below the bright sun.

aiReadySummary.title: Set Sail
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Set Sail
Category:Chinese opening themes
Set Sail (Chinese: Qǐháng) is the opening theme for the dub of the first season of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, . It debuted in HZ002, replacing Aim to Be a Pokémon Master -with my friends-. The opening animation has two versions that use the same footage as the corresponding Japanese opening themes, Heart-Pounding Diary and Halo.

The opening animation video for the song was released on various mainland Chinese social media platforms on January 17, 2025 as a trailer to promote the launch of the Pokémon Trading Card Game product .
